---
title: "How-to guides"
---

How-to guides are **task-oriented**: short, focused directions for
accomplishing a specific goal, assuming you already know the project's
basics. If you are still learning, start with the
[tutorials](../tutorials/index.qmd) instead.

## Available guides

### [Contribute to the project](contribute.qmd)

Set up your environment, edit documentation, and submit changes.

### [Add an indicator](add-indicator.qmd)

Add a health indicator to the measurement framework and data pipeline.
*In progress — the measurement framework (M1) and data catalogue (M2) are
taking shape in the [roadmap](../ROADMAP.md).*

### [Ingest a data source](ingest-data.qmd)

Add a source to the catalogue and pull it into the reproducible local
layout.
